Subject: Aligning a single demo time across US / EU / APAC (fallback plan)

Hi Elaine / team —

Thanks again for the interest in a short (30–40m) exec-level demo of Redwood Inference. We want to make sure we lock a time that works across your US, UK, and APAC execs without too many re-schedules. To reduce back-and-forth I sketched a small matrix below with three candidate slots and a fallback rule if one exec can only do "near-business-hours". Note: with recent DST changes the wall-clock offsets shifted — I called these out explicitly.

Candidate slots (wall-clock local times):
- Option A: 2026-12-21 09:00 PST / 17:00 GMT / 01:00 HKT (next day) — favors US morning + EU late afternoon (APAC late-night)
- Option B: 2026-12-21 13:00 PST / 21:00 GMT / 05:00 HKT (next day) — too late for APAC, borderline for EU
- Option C: 2026-12-22 00:00 PST / 08:00 GMT / 16:00 HKT — favors APAC afternoon, EU morning, US overnight

Fallback rule proposal: pick Option A unless an APAC executive explicitly declines; if APAC cannot attend, move to Option C and offer a condensed 20m exec summary for US attendees who would have to join overnight.

Could you confirm:
- which execs need to attend (names & regions)
- any absolute hard constraints (e.g., "no meetings before 08:30 local" or "not after 18:00")

I'll attach a one-sheet CSV with the same matrix for quick calendar import.

Attachments: proposed_time_matrix.csv (text/csv, 1KB)

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Appreciate the matrix. High level: our execs are

- Oliver Grant (EMEA CTO, prefers 9:00–17:00 GMT)
- Jing Wu (APAC strategy, Singapore / HKT timezone) — Jing copied.

Immediate constraints:
- Rebecca cannot do anything outside 08:00–11:30 PST on weekdays. DST difference noted — for the record we are on GMT (UK) and Singapore has no DST.
- Oliver is in the week of 20–24 Dec but has a hard stop on the 21st after 18:00 GMT.
- Jing is traveling 22–23 Dec (APAC local) and prefers anything before 17:00 HKT on 21 Dec.

Given that, Option A looks promising if we can shift it 30 minutes earlier for Rebecca (08:30 PST). Option B is late for Jing. Option C would make Rebecca join at midnight which she won't do.

I attached a short PDF with team avail windows.

Attachment: preferred_time_slots.pdf (application/pdf, 24KB)

Subject: Re: Aligning a single demo time across US / EU / APAC (fallback plan)

Thanks for the detail Elaine — quick internote from infra/ops side. Two things we see frequently that cause follow-ups:

1) DST / offset confusion: US moved back in early Nov, EU moved in late Oct. For your suggested slot (2026-12-21 08:30 PST) the offsets are: PST = UTC-8, GMT = UTC+0, HKT = UTC+8. That means 08:30 PST = 16:30 GMT = 00:30 HKT (22 Dec).

2) APAC attendance late-night: Jing mentioned travel — if Jing wants to avoid midnight, we should offer a single 20–25 minute exec summary for APAC attendees earlier in their day (e.g., 16:00 HKT on 21 Dec) and keep the longer product walkthrough for US/EU.

Concrete proposal from infra:
- Primary: 2026-12-21 08:30 PST / 16:30 GMT / 00:30 HKT (concise 30–40m demo).
- APAC-friendly alternate (summary only): 2026-12-21 16:00 HKT / 08:00 GMT / 00:00 PST (20m simultaneous summary) — this is effectively the same calendar date but reversed emphasis.

We can run the demo from our production environment and record for anyone who can't attend; recording will be available in the drive link after the call.

- Dylan
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
